testcase.name: Scenario: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:165:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon tab is selected ✔ And ribbon customization has not been opened earlier in the captured session ✔ When the user clicks "Customize" in the Options panel ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab ✔ And the target selector shows "Part | Tools" ✔ And the available-command category is "All Commands" ✔ And the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty beneath the "Large", "Text" and "Name" columns ✔ And "Import", "Export" and "Close" are available ✔ And "Cancel" and "Apply" are unavailable ✔ And no customization change is pending ✔ When the user clicks "Close" ✔ Then the dialog closes and the Tools ribbon remains visible
